evidence: Has the Wallet label and updates wallet transaction creation, signing, and PSBT handling in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp, src/script/sign.cpp, and src/psbt.cpp.
rationale: Allowing callers to restrict signing to Taproot key paths prevents accidental on-chain script-path reveals, saves fees, and avoids hardware signer bugs. While testing MuSig2 integration in #29675, the author noted that signing script paths alongside key paths triggered Ledger signer bugs and risks premature script exposure when co-signers could spend cooperatively.
